Middle Eastern crisis
2026 Iran war
2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East

2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis
Data from Kpler shows that seven ships have passed through the Strait of Hormuz, with four entering and three exiting the waterway. (Reuters)
Gaza war, Palestinian war crimes
The Israel Defense Forces accuses Hamas of using the Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis to carry out interrogations and torture Palestinians. (The Jerusalem Post)

2026 Mali offensives
Human Rights Watch reports that Africa Corps forces summarily killed nine civilians, including four children, in Mali last month. (Al Jazeera) (HRW)
Sudanese civil war
Kordofan campaign
The Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North led by Abdelaziz al-Hilu regains control of Kauda, South Kordofan, following two days of clashes with Otoro fighters. (Sudan Tribune)
Myanmar civil war
Unexploded ordnance from past fighting is detonated after being tampered with in Maungdaw Township, Rakhine State, Myanmar, injuring ten children. (Burma News International)

Business and economy

LSEG data shows that a vessel in France is loading wheat destined for Sudan, marking the first export of wheat from France to Sudan since August 2008. (Baird Maritime)

Disasters and accidents

Security Aviation Flight 45
Eight people are killed when a Cessna 441 Conquest II aircraft crashes at the Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site in Western Alaska, United States. (AA) (AP) (KTUU-TV)
A Mw 6.7 earthquake strikes the Parinacochas province in Peru. (AP)
Four railway workers on the Tōbu Nikkō Line are killed after being struck by a Limited express train in Kanuma, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. (BBC News) (The Japan Times)
Mauritania's coast guard rescues more than 300 migrants, including 40 children, from an overcrowded boat off the country's coast after finding them in distress. (AFP via L'Orient–Le Jour)
At least 13 Tunisians are missing and two are rescued after their boat capsized off Tunisia while sailing toward Italy, according to the Tunisian Observatory for Human Rights. One survivor is in critical condition. (Reuters)
Five people are reported missing and eight others are injured after a fire at a restaurant with apartments in Thusis, Grisons, Switzerland. (AFP via Kuwait Times) (BBC News)

Health and environment

2026 Ebola epidemic
The World Health Organization says that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine candidate developed by Merck to combat the Ebola outbreak in the country. (CNBC) (Africanews)

International relations

Ecuador–United States relations, Mexico–United States relations
The U.S. Treasury Department issues sanctions on 15 people allegedly involved in a drug trafficking network shipping thousands of kilograms of cocaine from Ecuador through Mexico to the United States. (AP)

Law and crime

2025 Mexican fuel smuggling scandal, Argentina–Mexico relations
Argentina deports a Mexican Rear Admiral accused of leading a fuel-smuggling network inside the Mexican Navy to Mexico after the Mexican government withdraws its extradition request. He is taken to the Altiplano maximum-security prison, where his brother and alleged co-leader, Vice Admiral Manuel Roberto Farías Laguna, is also imprisoned. (Infobae in Spanish)
Corruption in China, Chinese real estate crisis
A Chinese court sentences Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan to life imprisonment for financial fraud, bribery, and embezzlement, and fines Evergrande and its real estate arm a combined ¥15.8 billion (US$2.35 billion). (AFP via CNA)
Two ANC members including a former Knysna councillor are shot dead, one day after a sitting Knysna councillor is shot dead in a suspected internal ANC faction fight in Knysna, Western Cape, South Africa. (Knysna-Plett Herald)

Politics and elections

2026 Bangladeshi presidential election
The Jatiya Sangsad elects Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the President of Bangladesh in the first contested presidential election in 35 years. Alamgir will take office tomorrow. (Al Jazeera) (AP) (Dhaka Tribune)
Cameroon President Paul Biya returns to the country following a two-and-a-half-month absence. (Africanews)
Syrian Kurdish leader Mazloum Abdi says the integration of Kurdish military, security, and administrative institutions into the Syrian state is complete following an agreement reached with president Ahmed al-Sharaa in January. (AFP via France 24)

Sports

In American football, the National Football League fines the Dallas Cowboys and the New Orleans Saints $500,000 each after they started a brawl after a joint practice session at the Cowboys' facility in Oxnard, California, United States. (AP)

**There is no single objective ranking of the “10 best” places—travel is deeply personal—but across major sources like U.S. News & World Report, Lonely Planet, traveler surveys, expert lists, and bucket-list compilations, certain destinations consistently stand out for their natural beauty, cultural/historical significance, unique experiences, and widespread appeal.**<grok:render card_id="922c2d" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

Here’s a balanced selection of 10 iconic places that many people consider essential (presented in no strict order, with a mix of natural wonders, cultural landmarks, and diverse regions):

1. **Machu Picchu, Peru**  
   The iconic 15th-century Inca citadel set high in the Andes. Hiking the Inca Trail or arriving at sunrise remains one of the world’s great travel experiences.<grok:render card_id="6cf0ee" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

2. **Grand Canyon / National Parks of the American West (or Yellowstone/Glacier), USA**  
   The sheer scale of the Colorado River-carved canyon, layered geology, and vast landscapes deliver a profound sense of Earth’s power. Nearby parks add geysers, wildlife, and alpine scenery.<grok:render card_id="afbd24" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

3. **Rome (or broader Italy), Italy**  
   Layers of history from the Colosseum and Forum to the Vatican, combined with world-class food, art, and atmosphere. Italy as a whole frequently ranks among the top countries for culture and beauty.<grok:render card_id="7ba0e4" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

4. **Tokyo / Kyoto (or Japan overall), Japan**  
   A seamless blend of futuristic energy and ancient tradition—neon streets, serene temples, exceptional cuisine, and deep cultural immersion. Often cited as life-changing.<grok:render card_id="3b90af" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">10</argument></grok:render>

5. **Santorini / Greek Islands (or Greece), Greece**  
   Dramatic caldera views, whitewashed villages, volcanic beaches, and Aegean light make this a classic for beauty and romance. Greece regularly tops scenic rankings.<grok:render card_id="123e5d" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

6. **Serengeti / Tanzania (or broader East African safari)**  
   Witnessing the Great Migration of wildebeest and zebras, or close encounters with the Big Five, is frequently ranked among the most awe-inspiring wildlife experiences on Earth.<grok:render card_id="f79d95" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">2</argument></grok:render>

7. **Great Barrier Reef (or broader Australia), Australia**  
   The world’s largest coral reef system offers unmatched underwater biodiversity. Combined with Australia’s diverse landscapes (Uluru, coastlines, Outback), it ranks highly on all-time destination lists.<grok:render card_id="aaefa9" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">3</argument></grok:render>

8. **Petra, Jordan**  
   The ancient “Rose City” carved into sandstone cliffs is a UNESCO masterpiece of Nabataean engineering and one of the New Seven Wonders. Walking the Siq to the Treasury is unforgettable.<grok:render card_id="fcda15" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

9. **Paris, France**  
   Iconic architecture (Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Notre-Dame), museums, cuisine, and romantic atmosphere keep it near the top of city rankings year after year.<grok:render card_id="1dae6d" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">4</argument></grok:render>

10. **Antarctica (or Galápagos Islands as a more accessible alternative)**  
    Experts frequently rate a voyage to Antarctica as the ultimate travel experience for its otherworldly ice landscapes and wildlife. The Galápagos offer unique evolutionary biodiversity closer to the equator.<grok:render card_id="b21bb2" card_type="citation_card" type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">2</argument></grok:render>

### Honorable mentions
These often appear just outside the top tier or in specialized lists: Bali (Indonesia), New Zealand’s South Island, Swiss Alps, Cape Town/South Africa, Venice, Angkor Wat (Cambodia), Bora Bora, Iceland (Northern Lights/landscapes), and the Taj Mahal (India).

**Tips for visiting**: Prioritize based on your interests (nature, history, food, adventure), travel style, and budget. Many of these places face overtourism—consider visiting in shoulder seasons, supporting sustainable operators, and exploring lesser-known nearby areas. Rankings evolve yearly (e.g., Lonely Planet’s “Best in Travel” highlights emerging spots), so personal preference always matters most. Safe travels!

). Morocco is one of the safest and most accessible entry points, offering hikes, camel treks and an opportunity to sample authentic Berber culture. Admire the sculpted contours of Erg Chebbi and Erg Chigaga – seas of sand ever shifting with the tides of time.

Another trend: “We also saw a lot of low-impact glamping resorts, especially in more nature-based rural areas, and luxury train travel,” says Barker, whose personal favorites are the luxury train tours. “Belmond’s Eastern & Oriental Express, which runs through Malaysia, and the Diyarbakir Express through Turkey are two of the most notable.”

locations.

New Orleans’ historic French Quarter.
